description: Search speeches within a required parliamentary session, optionally by member, party, reply exclusion, heading tokens or related document. Heading matching covers debate headings only, never body text. relatedDocumentId returns the speeches the source links to a report or interpellation (riksdag_get_document supplies that search as relatedSpeechesCall); a resumed debate’s later segments can lack the link. Search hydrates one text page by default; use get mode with an item speechId to read all remaining text, keeping the returned revision for continuation.

headingContains.description: Search only: all-token local heading and subheading filter, ignoring case and diacritics; never body search.

limit.description: Search only: requested rows, default 5 and applied maximum 20.

memberId.description: Search only: numeric memberId from riksdag_search_members, keeping leading zeros.

mode.description: Search by default; get reads one retrieval speechId.

offset.description: Search only: local row offset, default 0.

party.description: Search only: official party code or exact reference label.

relatedDocumentId.description: Search only: report (bet) or interpellation (ip) document ID; returns the speeches the source links to it, case-insensitively, including joint debates linking several documents. A resumed debate’s later segments can lack the link; check headingContains with the report title.

revision.description: Search candidate revision or get textRevision copied from the preceding page.

session.description: Required in search mode; parliamentary session such as 2024/25.

speechId.description: Required in get mode: retrieval ID copied from a search item, never the source UUID.

speechType.description: Search only: all by default; speech excludes replies.

textCount.description: Search only: speeches to hydrate with text, default 1, maximum 5; 0 for metadata only.

textLength.description: Get only: Unicode code points per text page, default 8000.

textOffset.description: Get only: Unicode code-point offset, default 0.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Unknown party code, nonconsecutive session, punctuation-only headingContains or conflicting mode fields. `revision_changed`: Revision no longer matches. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: Source rows contradict the required identity. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Payload violates the wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: Source unavailable after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: Upstream queue is full. `candidate_limit_reached`: Complete-list safety limit reached. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
